points: Develop interactive, walkable digital-twin environments in Unity for visualizing and analyzing complex industrial assets.
Built runtime workflows for importing, processing, rendering, and interacting with large point-cloud datasets and Gaussian splats.
Designed and optimized spatial collision-detection algorithms for point-cloud and CAD geometry, improving runtime performance and user interaction.
Implemented a runtime CAD import pipeline so engineering models can be converted, visualized, and manipulated inside Unity.
Reproduced and validated the lab's virtual multi-staining deep learning pipeline (CycleGAN, RegGAN, Pix2Pix) on the dual-excitation PARS microscopy dataset.
Implemented full training and inference pipelines for virtual H&E staining, with hyperparameter tuning to reproduce published results.
Built a Flask GUI for the PARS virtual staining library to streamline internal testing and data visualization.
Programmed AlazarTech ATS digitizer cards in C++ (with an ImGui front end) for synchronized laser / actuator / digitizer triggering in real-time PARS imaging.

company: Computer Vision for Smart Structure Lab · University of Waterloo
points: Automated segmentation and templating of large-scale 3D point clouds by training AI models, sponsored by Ontario Power Generation under Prof. Haas.
Developed a Bill of Materials application with Flask and Postgres to store and categorize structural components.
Built automated and human-guided methods to estimate a point cloud's area, volume, and shape category for industrial components (beams, columns, floors).
Working toward publishing the segmentation and automation research.
Programmed, documented, and debugged in-house software including a Shipment Estimator, CRM, and OEM tooling.
Automated daily processes with PowerShell and Python scripting.
Built need-based applications in C# (WinForms/WPF) and PHP over Oracle and MySQL databases.
Analyzed production, inventory, and turnaround data with Crystal Reports, Power BI, and Excel.
Developed web applications with Angular and TypeScript from functional specifications.
Wrote unit and integration tests and supported test and production environments, using CI/CD for reliable builds.
Worked with SIEM tooling (IBM QRadar, CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) to detect and respond to cyber threats.
Automated firewall threat detection with MineMeld, aggregating OSINT threat intelligence.
Set up firewall rules during incident response and reported on emerging CVEs and breaches.
